feature: A cut click and a dropped clip answer inside the Premiere budget
summary: Clicking one of a clip's cuts now answers in 32 to 49 ms (was 47 to 59, median about 56), and letting a second clip go on the timeline reads 64 to 67 ms. The 760 ms freeze reported after the drop was the walk's own word check, not the app.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default.

try.do: Open Help > Tutorials and open the talk sample.
Click the ruler at about 0:04 and press Command K, then at 0:08 and press Command K again.
Click the first cut on V1: the panel switches to Edit point at once.
Click the middle piece, then the cut again, a few times quickly.
Drag a second recording from the Finder onto the end of V1 and let go.
Press Command Z, then Shift Command Z.

evaluate: Does clicking between a piece and its cut feel instant, with no stutter in the panel?
When the clip's sections leave on a cut click, do you ever catch them for a frame (a flash at the bottom of the panel)?
Does letting go of the second clip feel immediate?
Do Undo and Redo still feel a beat slow next to the clicks? They measure 51 to 71 ms and are the next task.
rough: Undo and Redo still hold 51 to 71 ms, over the 50 ms line: handed on as undo-and-redo-on-a-video-answer-inside-50-ms with what was found (panel header menus rebuilt on every Undo, and a gap in how the walks time a press).
No mock covers this: it changes speed only, nothing a person sees, so there is no side by side.
The cut click is under 50 ms with little room (most clicks 45 to 49 ms); the first cut of a session is the slowest because it builds the cut's sections for the first time.
